english.name: Amateur Bard
english.description: Collect your first musical instrument! Keep playing, even when everyone begs you to stop.

schinese.name: 业余吟游诗人
schinese.description: 收集你的第一件乐器！就算所有人都求你停下，也要继续演奏。

english.name: Perfectly Generic Achievement
english.description: Obtain the mythical perfectly generic item.

schinese.name: 完全普通的成就
schinese.description: 获得传说中的完全普通物品。

english.name: You're aMAZEing!
english.description: Complete Mazebound. You only need to beat it 300,000 times to win a slide whistle.

schinese.name: 迷宫高手！
schinese.description: 完成《迷宫无界》。只需通关 300000 次，就能赢得一个滑音哨。

english.name: Bug Tracker
english.description: Capture your first bug with a bug net. Esther would be proud.

schinese.name: 捕虫专家
schinese.description: 用捕虫网捉到你的第一只虫子。艾斯特会为你骄傲的。

english.name: Just like mum used to make!
english.description: Practice your chef skills. Try not to harm anyone.

schinese.name: 妈妈的味道！
schinese.description: 练习你的厨艺。尽量别伤到人。

english.name: Home Sweet Home
english.description: Attract your first colonist. Make sure you treat them right.

schinese.name: 甜蜜的家
schinese.description: 吸引你的第一位殖民者。记得好好对待他们。

english.name: First Mate
english.description: Recruit your first crew member. Captain!

schinese.name: 大副
schinese.description: 招募你的第一名船员。船长！

english.name: Alien Archaeologist
english.description: Restore a complete fossil. Make wild assumptions about what it used to be.

schinese.name: 外星考古学家
schinese.description: 修复一具完整的化石。尽情猜测它生前的模样。

english.name: Monster Whisperer
english.description: Capture a monster. How does it fit in that tiny ball?

schinese.name: 怪物低语者
schinese.description: 捕捉一只怪物。它是怎么塞进那么小的球里的？

english.name: Traveling in Style
english.description: Obtain a cool vehicle. Pop some sweet wheelies.

schinese.name: 拉风出行
schinese.description: 获得一辆酷炫的载具。来几个漂亮的翘头动作。

english.name: Book Club
english.description: Find a Codex. On Earth it's rude to read other people's diaries.

schinese.name: 读书会
schinese.description: 找到一份文献。在地球上，偷看别人的日记可不礼貌。

english.name: Augmented Reality
english.description: Augment your EPP. Now it's an AEPP.

schinese.name: 增强现实
schinese.description: 为你的环境保护装置安装增强模块。现在它就是增强版环境保护装置了。

english.name: Adventurer Eventuality
english.description: Complete a quest! Joke's on you, there isn't any XP in this game.

schinese.name: 冒险终将到来
schinese.description: 完成一个任务！被耍了吧，这游戏根本没有经验值。

english.name: The Resilient
english.description: Return Lana Blake to the outpost.

schinese.name: 坚韧者
schinese.description: 带拉娜·布莱克返回前哨站。

english.name: The Devout
english.description: Return Tonauac to the outpost.

schinese.name: 虔诚者
schinese.description: 带托努阿克返回前哨站。

english.name: The Wise
english.description: Return Koichi to the outpost.

schinese.name: 智者
schinese.description: 带光一返回前哨站。

english.name: The Brave
english.description: Return Nuru to the outpost.

schinese.name: 勇者
schinese.description: 带努鲁返回前哨站。

english.name: The Loyal
english.description: Return the Baron to the outpost.

schinese.name: 忠诚者
schinese.description: 带男爵返回前哨站。

english.name: The Protector
english.description: Defeat the Ruin.

schinese.name: 守护者
schinese.description: 击败毁灭之祸。

english.name: The Hopeful
english.description: Fix your ship.

schinese.name: 希望之光
schinese.description: 修好你的飞船。

english.name: Congratulations on Your Graduation!
english.description: Survive the Protectorate. It could have been worse.

schinese.name: 恭喜毕业！
schinese.description: 从守护团中幸存下来。情况本来可能更糟。

english.name: The Wanderer
english.description: Meet Esther.

schinese.name: 漫游者
schinese.description: 与艾斯特相见。

english.name: King Barbarian
english.description: Become champion of the arena. Crush your foes like an orange sorbet.

schinese.name: 野蛮人之王
schinese.description: 成为竞技场冠军。把敌人碾成橙子冰沙。

english.name: A Motley Crew
english.description: Recruit one crew member from every race. It's like a teeny tiny protectorate.

schinese.name: 杂牌船员
schinese.description: 每个种族各招募一名船员。就像一个迷你守护团。

english.name: Cosmic Curator
english.description: Complete the Cosmic Museum's cosmic collection.

schinese.name: 宇宙策展人
schinese.description: 集齐宇宙博物馆的宇宙藏品。

english.name: Too Heavy to Kick
english.description: Destroy a robot chicken. Don't try to eat it.

schinese.name: 重得踢不动
schinese.description: 摧毁一只机器鸡。别试着吃它。

english.name: Not in Front of the Children!
english.description: Defeat Mother Poptop. Every Poptop you meet from here on out is a lonely orphan.

schinese.name: 别当着孩子的面！
schinese.description: 击败波普顶母兽。从此以后，你遇到的每只波普顶都是孤儿。

english.name: Ending Prohibition
english.description: Defeat the dastardly Dreadwing. Bring joy to penguins everywhere.

schinese.name: 禁酒令终结
schinese.description: 击败卑鄙的恐翼。让各地的企鹅都欢欣鼓舞。

english.name: Shock and Awe
english.description: Defeat the Shockhopper MK I. Notice it rarely hops.

schinese.name: 震慑行动
schinese.description: 击败震荡跃击者一型。你会发现它很少跳。

english.name: A Helping Hand
english.description: Complete 10 quests for your colonists. Feel like an asset to the community!

schinese.name: 举手之劳
schinese.description: 为你的殖民者完成 10 个任务。感受一下为社区做贡献的快乐！

english.name: A Cheeky Chore
english.description: Complete 25 quests for your colonists. These guys sure do ask a lot of you don't they...

schinese.name: 琐事缠身
schinese.description: 为你的殖民者完成 25 个任务。这帮家伙还真会使唤人，不是吗……

english.name: A Tireless Task
english.description: Complete 50 quests for your colonists. When did this become your full time job?

schinese.name: 任劳任怨
schinese.description: 为你的殖民者完成 50 个任务。什么时候这成了你的全职工作？

english.name: Villain
english.description: Incapacitate an innocent bystander. You monster.

schinese.name: 恶棍
schinese.description: 击倒一名无辜的路人。你这个怪物。

english.name: Not a Llama
english.description: Obtain a complete alpaca costume. Use it only for good!

schinese.name: 不是美洲驼
schinese.description: 获得一整套羊驼服装。只能用它来做好事！

english.name: From the Ashes
english.description: Build a large colony. Well done Protector!

schinese.name: 浴火重生
schinese.description: 建立一座大型殖民地。干得好，守护者！

english.name: Cramped Colony
english.description: Build 5 homes in a very small space. This isn't a healthy way for anyone to live.

schinese.name: 拥挤的殖民地
schinese.description: 在极小的空间里建造 5 间住所。这样住可不健康。

english.name: Sweet Revenge
english.description: Kill 100 small flying monsters. They had it coming.

schinese.name: 甜蜜复仇
schinese.description: 杀死 100 只小型飞行怪物。它们自找的。

english.name: Nox's Apprentice
english.description: Kill another player. Unity is overrated anyway.

schinese.name: 诺克斯的学徒
schinese.description: 杀死另一名玩家。团结本来就被吹过头了。

english.name: Destroyer of Worlds
english.description: Move a planet's worth of blocks. If you weren't using a Matter Manipulator you'd be ripped.

schinese.name: 世界毁灭者
schinese.description: 搬动相当于一颗星球体积的方块。要不是用了物质操纵器，你早就练出一身肌肉了。

english.name: Protected Protector
english.description: Obtain an entire set of armour. Now use dye to make your armour fabulous.

schinese.name: 全副武装的守护者
schinese.description: 获得一整套护甲。再用染料把它染得漂亮点。

english.name: Feathered Friend
english.description: Recruit a penguin mercenary from the Beakeasy.

schinese.name: 有羽之友
schinese.description: 从企鹅酒吧招募一名企鹅雇佣兵。

english.name: Bug Free
english.description: Catch 42 unique bugs. Give them all funny names.

schinese.name: 一虫不漏
schinese.description: 捕获 42 种不同的虫子。给它们都起个滑稽的名字。

english.name: Culinary Century
english.description: Prepare at least 100 unique dishes. Bonus points if they're edible.

schinese.name: 百味大厨
schinese.description: 制作至少 100 种不同的菜肴。要是能吃，还能加分。

english.name: Them Bones
english.description: Unearth 55 unique fossils. Try not to pay attention to the ones that are alarmingly humanoid.

schinese.name: 这些骨头
schinese.description: 挖掘 55 种不同的化石。尽量别在意那些像人像得有点吓人的。

english.name: Mint Condition
english.description: Collect at least 50 unique action figures. Insist to your friends they're actually called statuettes.

schinese.name: 全新未拆
schinese.description: 收集至少 50 种不同的手办。坚持告诉朋友们，它们其实叫小雕像。

english.name: Armour Aficionado
english.description: Collect 210 unique pieces of armour. See how many you can wear at the same time. (Spoiler, it's 3).

schinese.name: 护甲收藏家
schinese.description: 收集 210 件不同的护甲。看看你能同时穿上多少件。（剧透：3 件。）

english.name: Well Read
english.description: Find 100 unique codex items. Study them all, prepare for a pop quiz.

schinese.name: 博览群书
schinese.description: 找到 100 种不同的文献物品。全部读完，准备突击测验。

english.name: Starbound Valley
english.description: Harvest 30 unique crops. Start thinking about who you'd like to romance and that barn extension.

schinese.name: 星界谷物语
schinese.description: 收获 30 种不同的作物。开始考虑追求谁，以及如何扩建谷仓吧。

english.name: The Simple Life
english.description: Harvest a crop. See what happens when you eat it.

schinese.name: 简单生活
schinese.description: 收获一种作物。尝尝看会发生什么。

english.name: Captain of the Year
english.description: Recruit at least 12 crew members. Consider starting a pension plan.

schinese.name: 年度船长
schinese.description: 招募至少 12 名船员。考虑给他们办个养老金计划吧。

english.name: All Walks of Life
english.description: Attract 10 unique tenants. Marvel at their collective peculiarity.

schinese.name: 各行各业
schinese.description: 吸引 10 种不同的租客。看看这群人凑在一起有多古怪。
